summary: Iteration 24 verified all four requested Dispatch changes on the public preview URL. Backend work-order filtering and checked-in/checked-out aggregate transitions passed. Frontend collapsible filters, Work Order filtering, active-count badge/clear, row 3-dot Edit/Cancel/Delete actions, attendance ticker values/colors, 30-second live refresh, and Status/Confirmation/Full History regressions passed.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated TEST_I24 backend and UI clients, vendors, officers, post sites, and schedules. Backend fixture teardown and browser finally blocks deleted schedules and deactivated reference data. No active iteration-24 test schedules remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview testing used admin@example.com. Work-order filter returned only WO-TEST-77 for case-insensitive TEST-77 and none for TEST-99. Stats changed by the expected baseline deltas after Check-in and Checkout. UI confirmed hidden-by-default filter grid, chevrons, badge clear, row menu actions, existing dropdown/history regressions, ticker/API parity for all five cells, and automatic checked-in increment without reload after the 30-second interval. One initial live-refresh assertion stopped on a Playwright Python argument-signature error; the selector/wait was corrected and the isolated live-refresh retest passed.
rca_of_the_issue: No product defect was found. The implementation wires the work_order query to a case-insensitive MongoDB regex, counts attendance statuses in dashboard stats, conditionally renders the filter grid and active badge, preserves row actions inside a Radix dropdown, and refreshes dashboard stats through a 30-second interval. The only interrupted attempt was test-harness syntax, not application behavior, and passed after correction.
